description: §41.12 — a registerMessages key that is not a ValidationError variant (`.TooShort`, the pre-catalog spelling of LengthFailed in the old §41.12 example) is refused with E-MESSAGE-VARIANT-UNKNOWN: no error carries that tag, so the entry could never be read.
rationale: §41.12: the map keys are ValidationError variants (§55.9); a key that is not one SHALL be refused with E-MESSAGE-VARIANT-UNKNOWN. Without it the template's slots cannot be checked either (the slot table is per variant).
